upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git svn or mercurial to the codereview app using upload.py
create_rpc_server_for_upload: create an HttpRpcServer instance to send authenticated RPC requests to the code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using the VersionControlSystem GenerateDiff method
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP upload requests
split_patch_by_file: split a combined patch string into separate pieces for each individual file
